title: Your First Weekend at Rowan University, Shared as Cards
description: A low-pressure first pass through campus resources, creative spaces, local history and recurring ways to get involved.

cards.title: Start with the Information Desk
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Chamberlain Student Center
cards.notes: Pick up a campus map, ask about shuttle schedules and scan current event information before choosing the rest of your weekend route.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for directions, campus resources and event pointers.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s Information Desk provides campus maps, bus/shuttle schedules, event information and Glassboro community information.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of the Chamberlain Student Center.

cards.title: Take a daylight campus walk
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Rowan University Arboretum
cards.notes: Use the outdoor loop to get oriented between campus buildings, then pause to notice the plantings and landscape that make up the arboretum.
cards.short_summary: A daylight walk that doubles as an introduction to campus landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan describes its arboretum as connecting people, plants and place through hands-on learning and environmental stewardship.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus destination; follow posted campus access guidance.

cards.entity_name: Rowan University Museum of Contemporary Art at 301 High Street
cards.title: See contemporary art downtown
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · 301 High Street West
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition online, then make time for a slow gallery visit and a look at the work’s labels before heading back toward campus.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission art stop in Rowan’s downtown gallery location.
cards.evidence_claim: RUMOCA at 301 High Street presents contemporary-art exhibitions; Rowan says its museum programming is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Rowan University Museum of Contemporary Art
cards.access_notes: The museum lists Tuesday–Friday and Saturday visiting hours; confirm the current exhibition schedule before going.

cards.title: Read the campus history at Hollybush
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Historic south edge of campus
cards.notes: View the historic exterior and, when a public tour or official function permits, look for the Summit artifacts that connect the mansion to 1967.
cards.short_summary: A landmark tied to the Glassboro Summit and Rowan’s earliest campus history.
cards.evidence_claim: Hollybush was the site of the 1967 Johnson–Kosygin Summit and now contains Summit artifacts for special University events.
cards.source_title: The Summit History | Hollybush | Rowan University
cards.access_notes: The mansion serves as a special-events venue; interior access depends on scheduled tours or events.

cards.title: Try the Rec Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Bring your Rowan ID, choose a comfortable activity and use the facility map to find the gym, track, pool or fitness areas that fit your plans.
cards.short_summary: A broad indoor recreation stop with fitness, court and aquatics spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rec Center includes a three-court gym, indoor track, 25-yard pool, racquetball courts, fitness areas and locker facilities.
cards.access_notes: Rowan says students carrying three or more credits have membership through the student activities fee; check current facility hours.

cards.title: Look for an intramural game
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Campus Recreation
cards.notes: Review the current intramural offerings, then join an activity at your comfort level or attend with a friend to learn how registration works.
cards.short_summary: A structured way to sample individual, dual or team recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan intramural sports offer individual, dual and team recreational activities for students of all ability levels.
cards.access_notes: Offerings and registration vary; consult Campus Recreation for the current schedule.

cards.title: Settle into Campbell Library
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Campbell Library
cards.notes: Find a seat, explore the library’s discovery tools and save one useful research or course-support contact for the first week of classes.
cards.short_summary: A focused campus stop for library help, collections and independent work.
cards.evidence_claim: Campbell Library supports the Glassboro campus with circulation, interlibrary loan, virtual help, welcome-desk support and research collections.
cards.source_title: Our Organization | Information Resources & Technology | Rowan University
cards.access_notes: Library access and service hours can vary by academic calendar period.

cards.title: Plan a planetarium show
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Science Hall
cards.notes: Check the current public-show calendar, choose a show that fits your weekend and arrive with enough time to handle ticketing before the program begins.
cards.short_summary: A public science-program stop built around immersive sky shows.
cards.evidence_claim: The Edelman Planetarium offers public shows, live stargazing and observatory open houses, with tickets available for public shows.
cards.access_notes: Public-show availability and ticket requirements vary; confirm the current schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Check the home-game calendar
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Richard Wackar Stadium
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled Rowan athletics event, confirm its admission details and take in the stadium setting with fellow spectators if a game is on.
cards.short_summary: A home venue for Rowan athletics and scheduled campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan identifies Richard Wackar Stadium as the venue where Profs cheer for the home team.
cards.access_notes: Admission, seating and event times depend on the specific athletics schedule.

cards.title: Choose one way to get involved
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Chamberlain Student Center
cards.notes: Browse student-organization information, note one club or event that interests you and ask Student Center staff how to follow its next meeting or program.
cards.short_summary: A final planning stop for turning a weekend introduction into a campus connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s Student Organization Services supports campus clubs and helps student organizations plan events through the Chamberlain Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Student Center staff can provide current organization and event information.
